messages:
alex: healthbot alerted: node k8s-usw2-gpu-045 showing ECC spikes + Xid bursts in last 10m. 3/6 GPUs reporting transient ECC counters. status: degraded. thinking: run soft-evac (grace 15m) with priority-aware replacement? pinging infra.
sree: can we delay if region capacity is low? APAC batch window starts in ~40m, don't want to trigger mass job reshuffles.
kevin: what does dedicated pool look like for us-west2 right now? if it's tight we should cordon-only and avoid full drain until off-peak.
alex: grafana: https://grafana.redwood-internal/r/abcd123/gpu-telemetry?panelId=7&from=now-30m — shows ECC counter slope and temp.
kevin: looks like ECC counters rising but no persistent Xid entries yet. temp peaked at 86C around the spike — could be thermal. any kubectl logs?
maria: proposal: make soft-evac policy priority-aware. if queued high-priority jobs >50% then extend grace to 45m and mark node as "candidate-replace" but defer hardware swap to maintenance window.
sree: how do we define "queued high-priority jobs" across k8s/slurm? slurm uses QOS, k8s uses priorityClass. need a unified predicate in controller.
alex: we can query schedulers; quick kubectl snippet: `kubectl get pods --field-selector=spec.nodeName=k8s-usw2-gpu-045 -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}:{.metadata.priorityClassName} {.spec.priority}{"\\n"}{end}'`
ops-bot: healthcheck run: ECC spikes detected at 03:12, Xid: none, temp spike 86C, fanRPM nominal. auto-evac suggestion: soft-cordon + drain after 15m if error persists. /run-id: e3f9
kevin: note: soft-cordon then drain could cause 2h delays for large slurm jobs if they get rescheduled. Can we preemptively migrate long jobs to DEDICATED-burst pool instead of killing?
maria: we have a burst pool but it's limited in us-west2 by reserved capacity. For short jobs we can proxy to hosted for cheaper short-term capacity.
alex: action items: 1) bump soft-evac threshold to 5 ECC spikes in 10m (current 3), 2) add region-aware grace increase when idle capacity <20%, 3) detect thermal patterns and prefer reboot before chassis replace for one-off thermal spikes.
sree: :thumbsup: I'll draft a PR for the controller. also add metrics: `evac_reason` and `evac_decision` tags so ops can trace rollouts/backfills.
kevin: also add node annotation `redwood/avoid-replace-until` (timestamp) so hardware replacement doesn't collide with scheduled maintenance.
alex: sample cordon+drain we use: ```kubectl cordon k8s-usw2-gpu-045 && kubectl drain k8s-usw2-gpu-045 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=900```
healthbot: created incident ticket INFRA-9876 for tracking.
maria: scheduling a 30m playbook review at 11:00 PT to walk through the new predicate and priority handling.
kevin: :eyes: will review capacity graphs and leave comments on the PR.
